backend/main.mo: Main canister actor handling property data, user profiles, access control, and query filters including furnishing status.
backend/migration.mo: Migration logic converting old property records to the new schema by adding furnishing, washrooms, and permit fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI features to affected frontend files and components with associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS variables and Tailwind base configuration for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/google-site-verification: Empty file included for Google site verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app with theme and notification providers.
frontend/src/components/agent/MultiPhoto: Component for uploading, previewing, tracking progress, and removing multiple property photos.
frontend/src/components/agent/PropertyFo: Form component for creating or editing property listings with fields, validation, and image upload support.
frontend/src/components/auth/AgentProtec: Route wrapper that restricts access to authorized agents and shows an access-denied screen if unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer displaying copyright info and a link to caffeine.ai with dynamic hostname tagging.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Header with site logo, navigation links, and entry to the agent area.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Page layout wrapper combining header, footer, and main content region.
frontend/src/components/listings/Contact: WhatsApp contact button that pre-fills a message referencing a property title.
frontend/src/components/listings/Propert: Card displaying a property's image, details, type badge, and price with navigation to its listing page.
Image gallery with main display and clickable thumbnail carousel for property images.
frontend/src/components/search/PropertyS: Search bar with filters, autocomplete suggestions, and keyboard navigation for property searches.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Hook that returns a debounced version of a value after a specified delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, roles, properties, and autocomplete suggestions via the actor backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining global theme variables, dark mode styles, and reusable component classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentArenaEntry: Agent login page validating an agent code and redirecting authorized users to the agent dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentDashboardP: Renders the agent dashboard showing property counts and quick actions, with logout and navigation handling.
frontend/src/pages/agent/ManagePropertie: Displays a list of agent properties with loading states and supports deleting listings with confirmation and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/agent/PropertyEditorP: Provides create and edit forms for properties, handling data submission, validation, and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Page that loads and displays detailed property information, including images, metadata, and navigation back to listings.
frontend/src/pages/PublicListingsPage.ts: Public listings page with a search bar that filters properties and displays search results or featured properties.
frontend/src/utils/agentCodeAuth.ts: Implements simple localStorage‑based agent authorization with verify, clear, and retrieval helpers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project version, architectural notes, known issues, and implemented features for a commercial property rental portal with a public frontend and an Agent Arena backend. Includes requirements for listing fields, WhatsApp behavior, and a code-based gate for agent access.
